origin.source_heading: LEVEL demonstration: Local Evidence, Verifiable Engineering Lifecycle
origin.interpretation: CORA defines a proposed game and proof method, not a completed game or a full narrative bible.

goal.claim: A new player can complete an original six-level 2D platform story, overcome three bosses, observe persistent checkpoints, receive accessible feedback and trace gameplay and assets to accepted requirements and independently witnessed execution.

story.setting: Ramecittà, a town where the Factory of Hours distributes time to everyone
story.premise: The clock apprentice Nilo discovers that six hours have been locked away; reclaiming them requires restoring the factory without taking time from anyone else.
story.theme: Time is shared; power over time must be accountable.
story.conflict: The Director of Hours hoards the six hours, transforming citizens' routines into rigid schedules.
story_arc: A clock that runs only for the powerful
Uncovering the cost of stolen minutes
Giving citizens control of their time
story.ending: The factory belongs to its citizens; Nilo learns to repair systems, not to control people.
nonclaims: No existing published franchise or protected character assets are licensed by this draft.
Creative originality and trademark clearance require human review.

characters.name: Nilo
characters.motivation: restore six missing hours without becoming a new timekeeper
characters.silhouette: small oval cap, triangular scarf, round watch
characters.interaction: runs, jumps, carries a winding key

characters.name: Tica
characters.motivation: record fair changes to the factory

characters.name: Direttore delle Ore
characters.interaction: three-phase final encounter, review before development

levels.title: Cortile delle Lancette
levels.story: first missing hour; learn the controls

levels.title: Archivio delle Ombre
levels.story: read who lost access to time

levels.title: Bosco delle Campane
levels.story: make decisions with Tica and Perno

gameplay.seed_engine: native HTML canvas with ES modules; no external gameplay engine
gameplay.security: no backend, no cookies, no telemetry, no requested permissions, no outbound requests
accessibility_targets: manual contrast and screen-reader assessment before release

slice.goal: one playable prologue with movement, camera, collisions, checkpoint persistence, HUD and finish

acceptance_oracles.claim: moving right advances Nilo and scrolls the camera
player does not fall through platforms on collision
activated checkpoint survives reload and resumes without invalid values
pause freezes movement, restart resets only transient state
visible HUD and instructions support an external user completing the prologue
a deliberately broken checkpoint write fails the negative oracle

allowed: create PR1 seed files and source-only tests in authorized NILO repository
local browser/manual play with operator consent
not_allowed: claim legal compliance or accessibility certification

risks.title: browser, host, OS and hardware not attested
independent code review and required checks unverified
